external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Das Edelweiss Salzburg Mountain ResortSeize the day in the fresh mountain air at Das Edelweiss Salzburg Mountain Resort, an Austria Alpine escape with a diverse selection of accommodations, restaurants offering mountain cuisine, a wellness spa with distinct adults-only and family areas, exciting activities, stunning views, and the chance to explore the peaks and valleys found nearby.

NANNAI Muro AltoFramed by calm, serene pools formed by an offshore coral reef, NANNAI Muro Alto is the ultimate tropical escape. Spend sun-soaked days on the sand or in the water, then retreat to the hotel for spa rituals, curated dining, tennis, yoga, and more. At night, relax further with stays in luxe apartments, spacious villa suites, or dreamlike bungalows.

Hôtel Dame des ArtsSip a cocktail and watch the sunset over the famous Paris skyline each night at Hotel Dame des Arts. Located in the bustling Saint-Germain neighborhood, enjoy easy access to the Louvre, Notre Dame, and Luxembourg Gardens. Stay in for a custom spa treatment, a sweat session at the gym, or dinner in the quaint courtyard.
The Leela Palace JaipurAn Opulent Palace Hotel Encouraging Traditional Indian Indulgence

Corso 281You’ll find no finer service or better location than Corso 281. After a cooked-to-order breakfast is delivered to your room, step outside into the heart of Rome's iconic landmarks. Schedule a wine tasting or a shopping tour with the attentive staff, and meet guests at the lounge in the evening for a toast to Italia!

Keio Plaza Hotel TokyoSavor a taste of Japanese culture when you stay in the heart of the capital at Keio Plaza Hotel Tokyo. Let the concierge arrange for a traditional tea ceremony, a kimono try-on, or a private local tour. Dine on flavors from around the world at the restaurants, sing karaoke, smoke a cigar in the lounge, or indulge in a spa treatment.

Haven Riviera CancunFeel the soft sand between your toes and the warmth of the Mexican sun at all-inclusive, adults-only Haven Riviera Cancun. Treat yourself to a Mayan therapy spa, or take a cooking class and brush up on Mexican dishes. Grab a drink at the pool swim-up bars, or find plenty of fun on the beach. Delight in the delicious on-site restaurants and nightly entertainment.

Rancho SantanaRancho Santana is the ultimate destination for a peaceful beach getaway or the opportunity to explore Nicaragua’s natural resources. Taste fresh fish and other organic ingredients grown on-site at the farm. Relax next to the water at the pool or beach, then indulge at the spa. Try paddleboarding, fishing, snorkeling, or horseback riding.

BEAUSiTE ZermattA destination design hotel set high in the snowcapped Swiss Alps in the car-free village of Zermatt, BEAUSiTE Zermatt is an elevated retreat where ski lovers and fresh air seekers are indulged with refined rooms, gourmet dining, an expansive spa with an array of saunas and pools, and a prime location near the region's best ski runs and lifts.
FORTH Hotel & Club - Atlanta, Georgia, United States
